name: Document Metadata
description: Parses a file you supply offline (ExifTool when installed), stores it hashed and summarises its metadata with sensitive values withheld.

inputs.label: Supplied by the 'Run with file' action

legal_notes: Only files you own or are authorised to analyse. GPS and similar values are RESTRICTED and shown only in the Imports tab.
quota_note: No network requests (works on local data)
example_output: File type, hash, camera/author metadata and counts; GPS withheld in the summary.
